description: Questions over the two sample PDFs. expected_sources lists the (filename, page) pairs that contain the answer; an empty list means the question is NOT answerable from the documents and the system should refuse.

questions.question: Who started Northwind Robotics?
questions.reference_answer: Dr. Elena Vasquez and Marcus Obi founded it.

questions.question: Where are Northwind's offices located?
During which hours do I need to be available?
questions.reference_answer: Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time.

questions.question: How many days a week do hybrid employees have to come into the office?
questions.reference_answer: At least two days per week, with Tuesday and Thursday as anchor days.

questions.question: How much money do I get to set up my home office?
questions.reference_answer: A one-time 600 USD equipment stipend plus 40 USD per month for internet.

questions.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get each year?
questions.reference_answer: 25 days of paid time off per calendar year.

questions.question: Can unused PTO roll over to next year?
questions.reference_answer: Yes, up to 5 days, which expire on March 31.

questions.question: How long is parental leave?
questions.reference_answer: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents.

questions.question: What is the daily food budget when travelling abroad for work?
questions.reference_answer: 100 USD per day for international trips.

questions.question: When am I allowed to book premium economy flights?
questions.reference_answer: For flights of six hours or more.

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting expense reports?
questions.reference_answer: Within 30 days of the purchase, in Ledgerly, with an itemized receipt.

questions.question: I clicked a phishing link. Who do I tell and how fast?
questions.reference_answer: Report it to security@northwind.example within one hour.

questions.question: How heavy a load can the Atlas-7 carry?
How long does it take to charge the robot's battery to 80 percent?
questions.reference_answer: 45 minutes from 0 to 80 percent with fast charging.

questions.question: How close can a person get before the robot comes to a full stop?
questions.reference_answer: The stop zone is 0.5 meters; it slows down at 1.5 meters.

questions.question: How often should the drive wheels be replaced?
What does error E204 mean and how do I fix it?
questions.reference_answer: Battery temperature high: move the robot somewhere cooler and let it rest 20 minutes.

questions.question: The robot doesn't know where it is anymore. What should I do?
questions.reference_answer: Error E450: drive it to the nearest fiducial marker and select Re-localize in the Fleet Console.
